options.why: One while loop can pop many pairs; the linear bound is over the lifetime of all stack entries.
No sort is used, and an O(n log n) sort would not prove this O(n) stack bound.
Equal heights are permitted and are consolidated by the >= condition; distinctness is unnecessary.
Each created pair is pushed once and popped at most once, so total stack work is linear.

items.explanation: Each stack lifetime contributes bounded work.
